title: Audio-Video Fusion Strategy (Interim, Proxy-Data Stage)
caveat: Neither modality is detecting rabies at this stage. Both models are trained on proxy data and output a 'agitation-likeness' score. Do NOT describe these outputs as rabies detection in any report, slide, or conversation.

audio_reliability.description: how trustworthy the audio score is, based on raw signal

video_reliability.description: how trustworthy the video score is, based on raw signal

confidence_signals.purpose: distinguishes 'I am sure this is agitated' from 'I have no idea'

fusion_rule.formula:
w_audio  = audio_reliability  * audio_confidence
w_video  = video_reliability  * video_confidence
final    = (w_audio * audio_score + w_video * video_score) / (w_audio + w_video + eps)
notes: When audio_present is False → w_audio = 0 → final falls back to video-only.
When video is dark → video_reliability ≈ 0 → final falls back to audio-only.
When both are weak → both weights near 0 → fusion emits low confidence, not a random score.

temporal_alignment.time_origin: t=0 at first video frame of the clip
temporal_alignment.rule: Both modalities emit one (score, reliability, confidence) triple per fusion tick. A modality's internal window may span several ticks; the value for each tick is the average over the windows overlapping that tick.

missing_modality_contract.present_field: explicit boolean, never a numeric sentinel

deployment_notes: Darkness threshold and silence threshold must be agreed in writing.
Both sides must resample onto the same 2 Hz grid before fusion.
Calibrate each modality separately, then fuse — do not fuse raw logits.
Log both raw and calibrated scores during testing for debugging.
